nodes.description: Private random secret number (1-10) players must guess; written by shuffle() and read by play().
Public timestamp of the last play() call; used as the cooldown reference in kill().
Public minimum bet price (0.1 ether) checked by play().
Public owner address, set from msg.sender in the constructor and checked in kill().
Public array of Game structs recording player and guessed number for each round.
Constructor: sets ownerAddr = msg.sender and calls shuffle().
Internal function that derives secretNumber from sha3(now, blockhash) - weak randomness.
Payable game entry point: validates bet, stores game, pays out on a correct guess, then reshuffles.
Owner-only self-destruct guarded by msg.sender == ownerAddr and now > lastPlayed + 1 days.
Payable fallback function that accepts plain ether transfers and can be re-entered.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, player and payout recipient.
now: miner-manipulable timestamp used as randomness seed, as lastPlayed value and in kill() cooldown.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) - external ETH send to an arbitrary caller.
suicide(msg.sender) - self-destruct sending all balance to the caller.
Temporary Game struct populated in play() before being pushed to gamesPlayed.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns ownerAddr directly from msg.sender.
Payout target of this.balance transfer is the untrusted msg.sender.
msg.sender is the destructive recipient of suicide() after the owner check.
play() writes msg.sender into game.player and the gamesPlayed entry.
block.timestamp (now) feeds the sha3 randomness used to pick secretNumber.
lastPlayed is assigned the current block timestamp at the end of play().
kill() gate depends on now > lastPlayed + 1 days, a timestamp condition.
Constructor invokes shuffle() to initialize secretNumber.
play() re-invokes shuffle() after every round.
play() executes the balance transfer when the guess matches secretNumber.
kill() executes suicide(msg.sender) when the owner and time conditions hold.
shuffle() writes the derived value into secretNumber.
play() pushes the filled Game struct into gamesPlayed.
play() reads secretNumber to decide whether the player wins.
External ETH transfer can re-enter the contract through the payable fallback (and then play()).
Guess parameter is range-checked and compared inside play().
Local Game structure is persisted into the gamesPlayed state array.

normalization_plan.reason: The number parameter is only a temporary input of play(); it has no standalone semantics and should be folded into the play() function node.
The game local variable is only a transient staging struct created and consumed inside play() before being pushed to gamesPlayed.
